<thought>All carbon NMR peaks between ~110–160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 138.76, 131.45 (twice), 130.59 (twice), and 121.30 ppm – six aromatic carbon signals, matching a benzene ring. Therefore the compound contains six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
